findings.evidence: Snapshot loads can choose v1 regardless of `tidb_schema_cache_size`: `pkg/domain/domain.go:321`, `pkg/domain/domain.go:327`, `pkg/domain/domain.go:328`, `pkg/domain/domain.go:539`. Full-load table fetch still switches to must-load-only when `SchemaCacheSize>0`: `pkg/domain/domain.go:490`, `pkg/meta/meta.go:1081`. v1 builder only materializes `di.Deprecated.Tables` and ignores `TableName2ID` unless v2: `pkg/infoschema/builder.go:934`, `pkg/infoschema/builder.go:953`. Runtime toggle window is explicitly expected: `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go:3152`.
findings.fix: When `useV2` is false (building infoschema v1), force the full-table meta path (`m.ListTables`) even if `SchemaCacheSize>0` (e.g., plumb `useV2` into `fetchAllSchemasWithTables`/`fetchSchemasWithTables` and gate `GetAllNameToIDAndTheMustLoadedTableInfo` on it; or pass an effective `schemaCacheSize=0` when `useV2=false`).
findings.impact: If `tidb_schema_cache_size` is enabled (>0) while the current/latest infoschema is still v1 (possible during the documented delayed-effect window), a snapshot infoschema cache miss can full-load using v1 but only “must-load” table infos, omitting most tables. Snapshot/stale-read, BR, and DDL code paths relying on `GetSnapshotInfoSchema` can see missing tables/metadata (e.g., unexpected `ErrTableNotExists`) or incorrect behavior.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master at `f0813a369666ac6314e76f5e573e982fe50c8a09`: snapshot keep-old v1/v2 logic and schemaCacheSize-driven must-load table fetch still exist (`upstream/master:pkg/infoschema/issyncer/loader.go:181`, `upstream/master:pkg/infoschema/issyncer/loader.go:493`, `upstream/master:pkg/infoschema/issyncer/loader.go:606`).
findings.verify: Manual scenario: start with `tidb_schema_cache_size=0` (v1), ensure snapshot TS older than infoschema cache coverage, `SET GLOBAL tidb_schema_cache_size='512MB'`, then immediately run a stale-read (`AS OF TIMESTAMP` / snapshot) query against a non-must-load table; expect table resolution to succeed (currently can fail on cache miss).
findings.what: Snapshot infoschema full-load can build infoschema v1 while `tidb_schema_cache_size>0`, but schema/table fetching is still optimized for v2 and only loads “must-load” table infos; v1 builder then omits most tables, yielding an incomplete snapshot infoschema.

subject: domain,infoschema: avoid v1/v2 switch when loading snapshot infoschema (#55129)
summary: Found 1 Blocker in snapshot infoschema loading: a cache-miss full load can build v1 while `tidb_schema_cache_size>0` but still uses v2’s must-load-only meta fetch, producing an incomplete snapshot schema; not fixed in upstream/master.
